note: Both sets cover all nine cells of Table 5.5-4 with the correct numeric ranges, and both equally drop the (science)/(guide) mode qualifiers that are the real conditions in the table. Set A instead labels the channel as a 'condition' and in two claims names the entity 'UV band' / 'Visible band' while the attribute is the IR bandpass (1.6–1.8 µm), which is internally contradictory and misbound.
